title: Sum from 1 to N
statement: Write a function sum_to_n(n) that takes a positive integer n and returns the sum of all integers from 1 to n inclusive.

title: Calculate Average
statement: Write a function average(nums) that takes a non-empty list of numbers nums and returns their float mean average.

title: Count Even Numbers
statement: Write a function count_evens(nums) that returns the count of even integers in the list nums.

title: Factorial of N
statement: Write a function factorial(n) that returns n! for a positive integer n.

title: Find Maximum in List
statement: Write a function max_of_list(nums) that returns the maximum number in a non-empty list nums.

title: Add Item to List
statement: Write a function add_item(lst, x) that appends x to list lst and returns the updated list.

title: Double Each Element
statement: Write a function double_each(nums) that returns a new list with every element of nums doubled.

title: Read Inputs and Add
statement: Write a function read_and_add(a, b) that converts two string inputs a and b to integers and returns their sum.
canonical_solution:
def read_and_add(a, b):
    return int(a) + int(b)

title: Square of Number
statement: Write a function square(x) that takes a number x and returns its square (x * x).

title: Sum in Range [a, b]
statement: Write a function range_sum(a, b) that returns the sum of integers from a to b inclusive (assume a <= b).
